subject.title: docs: map the algorithmic closure system

question: Does the rebased guide accurately describe the current implementation status, ordering, and authorization boundaries across all six algorithmic-closure layers?
rationale: CI can validate links and formatting but cannot confirm that a broad cross-system architecture document correctly characterizes active code and in-flight rollout behavior.

options.title: Validate And Merge
options.body: Area owners verify the rebased status table, action inventory, ordering, and authorization boundaries and approve the guide as canonical.

options.title: Document Stable Guarantees Only
options.body: Remove planned and in-rollout assertions, retaining only behavior directly established on current main.

options.title: Wait For Rollout
options.body: Keep the draft open until the referenced implementation stack lands, then rewrite the guide against observed final behavior.

recommendation.title: Validate And Merge
recommendation.body: Area owners verify the rebased status table, action inventory, ordering, and authorization boundaries and approve the guide as canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository member authored every revision of the document and is the best visible coordinator for obtaining the required subsystem-owner validation.
